root_cause: Revision counters / group list / chat & poll versions are per-tab React state over shared origin storage; no cross-tab signal existed, so a write in tab A (e.g. archiveContact) was invisible to tab B until reload.
fix: S0: app/src/lib/crossTab.ts — single BroadcastChannel('few-tabs'), typed {type:'store-changed',store,id?} (stores blocked|known|contacts|groups|chat|polls), parse/validate on receipt, post+listen on one channel object (no echo), SSR/Node no-op shim, postStoreChanged never throws, channel closed with the last listener, factory test seam. Writers post only after a successful write: contacts.ts (writeStoredContacts->contacts; archive/unarchive->blocked; purge->contacts), contactCache.ts->contacts, knownPeers.ts writeRaw->known, groupStorage saveGroup/deleteGroup/clearAllGroupMeta->groups(id), chatPersistence append/update/tombstone/remove/clear->chat(groupId) only when a row changed, pollPersistence savePoll/saveVoteIfNewer(wrote)->polls(groupId). Receiver: crossTabReceiver.applyStoreChanged (pure) wired by one MarmotContext effect to setBlockedPeersRevision/setKnownPeersRevision/setContactsRevision/reloadGroups()+setGroupDataVersion/setChatVersion/setPollVersion; actions never write.

Failed before the fix (chat-input still 1 after 15s), passes after.
verification_answers.VQ-2: Yes. Exactly one channel module (crossTab.ts), typed StoreChangedMessage, SSR/Node no-op shim, no echo handling needed (post and listen share one BroadcastChannel). All report-listed writers wired, posting only after a successful write. Note: blockedPeers.ts and blockContactAction.ts perform no storage write themselves — the block write is contacts.ts archive/unarchiveContact, which posts 'blocked'. Reactions not wired: its store reads from an in-memory cache, so a bump alone would not refresh another tab (no working reload hook) — left as a non-goal.
verification_answers.VQ-3: Yes. Fake injected channel; crossTab-writers.test.ts covers each writer's store/id and failure injection at every touched storage step; crossTab.test.ts covers applyStoreChanged per store (exact action set) and a source scan pins MarmotContext's action->setter wiring.

retrospective.harder_than_needed: The report names blockedPeers.ts / blockContactAction.ts as writers, but neither writes storage (the block lives in contacts.ts archivedAt); and 'reaction stores' looked wireable but the reactions module serves reads from an authoritative in-memory cache, so cross-tab support needs cache invalidation, not a counter bump.
retrospective.surprised_by: Reactions cache makes a cross-tab bump a no-op; left unwired rather than invalidating a cache whose authority guards a known badge-revival race.

items.1_dm_thread_cross_tab: crossTab.subscribeStoreChangedFor(store,id,cb); ContactChat subscribes for ('chat', threadId) and re-reads storage through ChatStoreContext.reconcileMessagesWithStorage (storage row wins, new rows added, tombstones filtered, pending optimistic sends kept). Unsubscribes + cancels on unmount/thread change.
